put.description:
Check and save the settings; they apply from the next run.

Invalid settings are refused with every problem listed, and the file is left as it
was. The file is rewritten without its comments; the hidden keys are kept.

put.description:
Book with MuMu instance ``mumu_index`` beside the first, or stop.

On, it gets an ``[[instances]]`` table that takes every setting from the top of the
file until the app changes them; off, its table goes. No ``enabled`` key is written: a
runner of an older version refuses keys it does not know. Invalid settings (422)
leave the file as it was; the first machine's own instance is refused (400).

put.description:
Switch the daily booking on or off.

Switching on needs a passed dry run (409 ``dry_run_required``) and a wake time before
the start time (400 ``bad_request``). It installs the task again each time, so a new
wake time applies, and allows wake timers; ``wake_blocked`` in the Overview tells when
Windows still keeps them off. The task runs the engine of this backend; in development, the
runner folder keeps its task through ``tools/setup_runner.py`` instead.

post.description:
Start a dry run of the saved settings; it stops before "Xác nhận".

Refused (400 ``bad_request``) from the wake time to 5 minutes after the start time and
(409 ``lock_held``) while a run holds the lock, or while the dry run started last is
still running (it may not hold the lock yet). The dry run checks again itself.

Every booking setting; the UI changes the slots, subdivision, sport and court, and sends
the rest back.

Step.description:
One step of the activity log; ``kind`` is the message key, ``data`` its values.

``kind`` and ``category`` are listed in the schema, so the UI's types name every step
and a step without a message fails its type check.
